metadata.repo_type_justification: Application source code (TypeScript) with a deployable entry point (Lambda handler in src/server.ts), a dependency manifest (package.json), and IaC (infra/template.yaml SAM template) provisioning AWS resources for a single service.
metadata.archetype_justification: DynamoDB persistent state with CRUD operations (upsert, soft-delete, read) via GraphQL mutations and queries. Write endpoints present alongside reads. No multi-service orchestration.

classification_consistency_check.reason: Score 2.92 yields Partial band (maps to Pilot-Ready) but 3 High findings force Remediation Required tier. The system has strong infrastructure foundations (serverless, managed DB) but critical operational maturity gaps (no CI/CD, no deployment strategy, no tests) that produce High-severity findings.

top_gaps.title: CI/CD Automation
top_gaps.gap: No CI/CD pipeline — all deployments manual
top_gaps.impact: Blocks safe, repeatable deployments and all Modern DevOps practices

top_gaps.title: Deployment Strategy
top_gaps.impact: Regressions affect all users immediately with no rollback mechanism

top_gaps.title: Integration Testing
top_gaps.impact: No regression safety net; changes deploy without validation

top_gaps.title: API Versioning Strategy
top_gaps.gap: No API versioning strategy for GraphQL schema
top_gaps.impact: Breaking schema changes affect all consumers simultaneously

top_gaps.impact: Vulnerabilities in dependencies reach production undetected

findings.title: Async Messaging and Streaming
findings.description: This stateful-crud service uses synchronous request-response for all operations. No messaging infrastructure (SQS, SNS, EventBridge) is configured. State changes are not propagated via events.
findings.gap: No event emission on state changes. A stateful-crud service managing product catalog state should emit domain events for downstream consumers.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge integration to emit domain events on product mutations for audit trails and downstream service integration.

findings.title: Network Security
findings.description: Architecture uses fully managed services communicating over AWS-internal networking with IAM-based access. No VPC endpoints for DynamoDB access.
findings.gap: Lambda-to-DynamoDB traffic traverses the AWS public endpoint rather than a VPC endpoint or PrivateLink.
findings.recommendation: Consider placing the Lambda in a VPC with a DynamoDB VPC Gateway Endpoint for enhanced security posture.

findings.title: Backup and Recovery
findings.description: DynamoDB has PITR enabled providing continuous backups with 35-day retention. No cross-region backup replication or documented restore procedures.
findings.gap: No cross-region backup replication for disaster recovery. No documented restore procedures or regular restore testing.
findings.recommendation: Add an AWS Backup plan with cross-region copy rules. Document and periodically test restore procedures.

findings.title: Infrastructure as Code Coverage
findings.description: SAM template covers primary resources (Lambda, DynamoDB, HttpApi, Cognito authorizer). Missing operational/DR IaC resources.
findings.gap: No CloudWatch alarms, dashboards, SNS topics, or AWS Backup plans in IaC. Estimated 70-80% coverage.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda errors, DynamoDB throttling, and API Gateway 5xx rates. Add SNS topic for notifications.

findings.title: CI/CD Automation
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline configuration found. No GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CodeBuild, or any pipeline definition. Deployments are entirely manual.
findings.gap: Complete absence of CI/CD automation. All deployments require manual execution.
findings.recommendation: Implement a CI/CD pipeline with stages: lint, build, test, deploy-staging, integration-test, deploy-production using SAM CLI.

findings.title: Async vs Sync Communication
findings.description: Service operates as synchronous request-response. No outbound service calls. No event emission on state changes. Synchronous model is appropriate for the read/write path.
findings.gap: State changes (product upsert, delete) are not emitted as domain events. Downstream services cannot react to catalog changes asynchronously.
findings.recommendation: Add EventBridge event emission on mutations to enable downstream integration. This is a growth capability, not a structural flaw.

findings.title: API Versioning Strategy
findings.description: No API versioning strategy. GraphQL endpoint at /graphql with no version prefix. No @deprecated directives in schema. No changelog.
findings.gap: No versioning mechanism. Breaking schema changes affect all consumers simultaneously.
findings.recommendation: Adopt a schema evolution strategy: use @deprecated directives, document a changelog, establish a deprecation policy for field removal.

findings.title: Service Discovery
findings.description: DynamoDB table name injected via environment variable from CloudFormation. No hard-coded endpoints. No dynamic service discovery.
findings.gap: Environment variable injection only — no service registry, API catalog, or service mesh for dynamic discovery.
findings.recommendation: Register the GraphQL endpoint in AWS Cloud Map or publish as API Gateway stage export for service-to-service discovery.

findings.title: Encryption at Rest
findings.description: DynamoDB table has server-side encryption enabled using AWS-owned default key. All data at rest is encrypted.
findings.gap: AWS-managed encryption rather than customer-managed KMS keys. No explicit key rotation policy or access audit.
findings.recommendation: Consider upgrading to a customer-managed KMS key for sensitive data with key rotation control and CloudTrail audit.

findings.title: Compute Hardening and Patching
findings.description: Lambda runtime (Node.js 20) managed by AWS. ARM64 Graviton architecture. No dependency vulnerability scanning configured.
findings.gap: No dependency vulnerability scanning or update automation. Application dependencies have no automated vulnerability monitoring.
findings.recommendation: Add Dependabot/Renovate for dependency updates. Add npm audit to the CI pipeline. Consider AWS Inspector for Lambda scanning.

findings.title: Application Security Pipeline
findings.description: No security scanning tools configured. No CI/CD pipeline exists. No Dependabot, SAST, or container scanning.
findings.gap: Complete absence of application security scanning. Vulnerabilities reach production undetected.
findings.recommendation: Add npm audit as a pipeline gate, Dependabot for dependency updates, and Semgrep/CodeGuru for SAST.

findings.title: Distributed Tracing
findings.description: X-Ray Active tracing enabled on Lambda function. Automatically traces Lambda invocations and DynamoDB calls.
findings.gap: No explicit trace context propagation in application code or custom instrumentation for business-level spans.
findings.recommendation: Add custom X-Ray subsegments for business operations. Ensure trace headers are propagated if additional services are added.

findings.title: SLO Definitions
findings.description: No SLO definitions found. No CloudWatch alarms on latency or error rates. No monitoring artifacts.
findings.gap: No formal SLO definitions for the GraphQL API. No latency targets, availability targets, or error rate thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Define SLOs: p99 latency < 200ms, availability > 99.9%, error rate < 0.1%. Add CloudWatch alarms.

findings.title: Business Metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics published. Only default Lambda/API Gateway infrastructure metrics available.
findings.gap: No business outcome metrics: no tracking of products created/updated/deleted or catalog query rates.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch custom metrics for business events using Embedded Metric Format for zero-latency emission.

findings.title: Anomaly Detection and Alerting
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms. No integration with notification services.
findings.gap: Complete absence of alerting. Service degradation goes unnoticed until users report issues.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for Lambda errors, duration p99, API Gateway 5xx, DynamoDB throttling. Route to SNS.

findings.title: Deployment Strategy
findings.description: No deployment strategy. Lambda updates deploy all traffic immediately with no staged rollout, canary, or blue/green mechanism.
findings.gap: Direct-to-production deployment. A bad deployment affects 100% of traffic immediately with no automated rollback.
findings.recommendation: Add SAM DeploymentPreference: Canary10Percent5Minutes with CloudWatch alarms as rollback triggers.

findings.title: Integration Testing
findings.description: No test files exist in the repository. vitest configured in package.json but no test files found.
findings.gap: Complete absence of automated tests. No regression safety net.
findings.recommendation: Add unit tests for resolver logic, integration tests with DynamoDB local, and include in CI pipeline.

findings.title: Incident Response Automation
findings.description: No runbooks, SSM Automation documents, or self-healing patterns found.
findings.gap: Incident response is entirely ad hoc. No defined procedures for common failure modes.
findings.recommendation: Create runbooks for common failures. Graduate to SSM Automation for automated remediation.

findings.title: Observability Ownership
findings.description: No observability ownership. No CODEOWNERS file, no service dashboards, no alarm ownership.
findings.gap: No clear ownership of monitoring and observability. No responsible party defined.
findings.recommendation: Add CODEOWNERS, create a CloudWatch dashboard, define alarm ownership and escalation paths.

findings.title: Resource Tagging Governance
findings.description: No tags on any AWS resource in the SAM template. No cost allocation, ownership, or environment identification.
findings.gap: No tagging governance. Cannot track costs or identify resource ownership.
findings.recommendation: Add Tags section to SAM Globals: Service, Team, Environment, CostCenter.

evaluations.title: Managed Compute
evaluations.reason: All compute on Lambda (serverless) with Node.js 20 ARM64.

evaluations.title: Managed Databases
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB fully managed with PAY_PER_REQUEST, SSE, and PITR.

evaluations.title: Workflow Orchestration
evaluations.reason: No multi-step workflows exist in this stateful-crud service. All operations are single-step DynamoDB calls.

evaluations.title: API Entry Point
evaluations.reason: API Gateway HttpApi with Cognito JWT authorizer as entry point.

evaluations.title: Auto-Scaling
evaluations.reason: Lambda and DynamoDB PAY_PER_REQUEST both scale automatically.

evaluations.title: High Availability and Fault Isolation
evaluations.reason: All services (Lambda, DynamoDB, API Gateway) are inherently multi-AZ.

evaluations.title: Programming Languages
evaluations.reason: Node.js 20 + TypeScript 5.4 + AWS SDK v3 + Apollo Server 4 — modern cloud-native.

evaluations.title: Monolith vs Microservices
evaluations.reason: Single-purpose microservice with dedicated DynamoDB table, independently deployable.

evaluations.title: Long-Running Process Handling
evaluations.reason: All operations are fast DynamoDB point operations completing in milliseconds. No long-running processes.

evaluations.title: Unstructured Data Storage
evaluations.reason: Service stores only structured data in DynamoDB. No unstructured data to manage.

evaluations.title: Unified Data Access Layer
evaluations.reason: All database access centralized in single resolver module via context-injected DynamoDB client.

evaluations.title: Database Engine Version and EOL
evaluations.reason: DynamoDB is versionless — fully managed with no EOL concern.

evaluations.title: Stored Procedures and Schema Complexity
evaluations.reason: No stored procedures. All business logic in application layer. DynamoDB does not support stored procedures.

evaluations.title: Audit Logging
evaluations.reason: Application-level IaC only. CloudTrail is an account-level service that belongs in foundation infrastructure repo.

evaluations.title: API Authentication
evaluations.reason: Cognito JWT authorizer on all endpoints with scope-based mutation authorization.

evaluations.title: Centralized Identity Integration
evaluations.reason: Amazon Cognito User Pool for centralized identity with JWT scopes.

evaluations.title: Secrets Management
evaluations.reason: No secrets to manage. IAM role-based access for Lambda-to-DynamoDB. No hardcoded credentials.
